scope: Static definitions and reachable wrapper callsites in associated caches; not dynamic launch counts or proof that failed attempts executed these graphs
limits: Reused kernel names match many-to-many within that graph context; this is coverage, not exact per-node/per-call attribution.
Preexisting/shared caches may contain old graphs; absence of events is unknown, not a proven new missing lowering.
Static branches and dispatch candidates do not establish which path executed; definitions alone are not launches.
Python/eager graph breaks and kernels outside retained Inductor wrappers are outside this source inventory.
Native operator callsites can be views or metadata operations; they are not necessarily GPU launches or unsupported FlyDSL operations.
Live/failed/archived contexts are retained for coverage only; their timing values are not combined.
